key_idea: Eggs next to each other or one above the other touch, so each column can hold only 1 brown egg.
steps: The box has 2 rows with 4 eggs in each row, so there are 4 columns.
The 2 eggs in the same column touch, so each column can have at most 1 brown egg.
Put brown eggs top, bottom, top, bottom, going across. They only meet corner to corner, so they do not touch.
That is 4 brown eggs, and 5 is not possible with only 4 columns.

choice_feedback.A: You can fit more: one brown egg in each column works.
choice_feedback.B: You can fit one more: one brown egg in each of the 4 columns.
choice_feedback.D: With 5 brown eggs, 2 of them would be in the same column and touch.
choice_feedback.E: With 6 brown eggs, many of them would touch each other.
